queries: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field FROM per_race) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.field_size) AS avg_field_size, AVG(p.field_size - o.avg_field) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.field_size > o.avg_field

assumptions.assumption: Field size for a race name is the count of driverStandings rows (inner-joined to races) across all years for that name, not distinct drivers.
The overall average field size is the unweighted average of field sizes across race names (each race name counts once).
Average points per race name ignores NULL points via AVG; field size counts all matched standings rows, including those with NULL points.

alternatives.interpretation: Field size means the number of distinct drivers appearing in standings for that race name.

The overall average field size is the unweighted mean of field sizes across race names (each race name counted once).
Average of average points is an unweighted mean of the per-race-name averages.
